design.site_summary: A shady microclimate balcony with a curious cat named Leo, requiring a lush, layered planting scheme using only verified safe species.
design.layout_strategy: Hanging trailing plants above eye level on the railing, upright perennials at mid height against the shaded wall, and a low ground layer along the balcony floor edge for cat accessibility.
design.combination_logic: The plants work together through contrasting textures between the weeping fronds of the hanging basket and the sturdy, upright foliage of the mid and ground layers. This creates a multi-tiered green display that thrives in full shade.

zones.placement: on the north-facing railing, receiving 2 hours of indirect morning light and full shade, sheltered from harsh winds.

plants.why: Provides a lush trailing habit suitable for hanging baskets.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds fine-textured, cascading greenery that softens the hard edge of the balcony railing.

maintenance: Water thoroughly when the top inch of soil feels dry.
Feed with a balanced liquid fertilizer monthly during the growing season.

zones.placement: against the north-facing back wall, full shade, receiving minimal direct sunlight.

plants.why: Thrives in full shade conditions and adds striking structural contrast at mid-height.
plants.role_in_combination: Serves as a focal point with broad, strap-like leaves that contrast with the fine texture of the hanging fern.

maintenance: Water moderately, allowing the soil to dry slightly between waterings.
Remove spent flower stalks at the base after blooming finishes.

zones.placement: on the north-facing balcony floor edge, easily reachable by the cat, full shade with ambient indirect light.

plants.why: Provides a robust, accessible ground-level presence that anchors the design.
plants.role_in_combination: Offers height variation at the floor level and creates a solid structural anchor for the lower tier.

maintenance: Water when soil is dry to the touch at a depth of two inches.
Wipe broad leaves periodically to remove accumulated dust.

care_instructions.task: Check soil moisture across all containers and water thoroughly when dry
care_instructions.frequency: twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Apply a dilute balanced fertilizer to support foliage growth
Inspect container drainage holes and clear any debris to prevent water stagnation

care_cautions: Overwatering the Asparagus densiflorus cv sprengeri in the hanging basket can lead to root rot.
The Clivia minata in the mid-layer requires protection from sudden frost exposure during winter nights.
Leo the cat should be monitored around the Floor Grazing Zone to prevent excessive chewing on the Dracaena fragrans leaves.
design.pet_safety_note: The design keeps your cat Leo safe by utilizing verified plant placements and monitoring access to the ground-level zone.
